title: Criteria-governed seismic alarm triage in sparse networks: code, pre-specified test plans and results
description: Code, pre-specified test plans, per-episode decision records and result files for the manuscript "Missing versus Non-Confirming Neighbour Evidence in Sparse Seismic Alarm Triage: A Criteria-Governed Rule Tested at Kazakhstan and Alaska Stations" (S. Zhakypbekov, A. Bykov, A. Abzhanova, T. Imanbekova, E. Lavrov, A. Shaikemelova, R. Mametova; prepared for Sensors, MDPI) and for a companion study of 38 seismic networks. Paper 1 tests a rule that gives a missing neighbour record no weight and a valid non-confirmation a reliability weight, at two Kazakhstan reference stations, a second Kazakhstan network, Alaska and a time-disjoint 2023 period. MANIFEST_PAPER1.md maps every table of Paper 1 to its script and result file; results/provenance/prespecification_timeline.json dates each pre-specified plan by its push time and the first data request. The test plan of the 38-network study is registered on OSF: https://osf.io/y8qxz (DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/Y8QXZ). Source repository: https://github.com/Syrym-Zhakypbekov/sparse-seismic-criteria-governed-triage
